label: Washington State
title: WSU Radio Networks - Washington State University Athletics - Official Athletics Site
said: WSU Radio Networks - Washington State University Athletics - Official Athletics Site
Washington State football games are broadcast live on the radio across the region via the Cougar Sports Network.

The Cougar Sports Network also features radio coverage of WSU men’s basketball, women's basketball, and baseball, along with the Cougar Football and Basketball Hours during the fall and winter seasons.
On the App: Download the WSU Cougars Gameday app to listen.
SiriusXM Radio: All football games are also available on SiriusXM satellite radio.
Chris King enters his third season as Voice of the Cougs, handling play-by-play duties for WSU football, men’s basketball and select baseball games along with hosting coaches shows and podcasts.
He has previously been part of the Cougar Roadshow pregame broadcast and was a contributor on NBCSports Northwest as well as ESPN 1080 and Rip City Radio in Portland.

McIntyre is the assistant program director of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR in Seattle and previously was an executive producer for Q13 FOX in Seattle, was an executive producer for 710 ESPN Seattle (2009-20) and for ESPN Radio in Bristol, Conn.
